title: The empty-contract refusal says to add a criterion but not to satisfy it, so its remedy leads to a second refusal
body:
Seen (laksa-vc, 2026-09-23, upgrading Laksa to the installed 3.2.0 build): the done gate refused `intent wp done` on three finished work packages under completed threads that predate acceptance criteria, with "the thread has zero acceptance criteria (empty contract). Define ACs with `intent ac new`, or cancel the unit with `intent st cancel` or `intent wp cancel`." (`native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/contract.rs:596`). laksa-vc closed them by adding one non-test criterion each, satisfying it by named evidence (`intent ac satisfy --evidence <ref> <STID> <ACID>`), and then running `wp done`.

The remedy names half the path. A criterion added with `ac new` is unsatisfied, so following the remedy leads straight to a second refusal. For historical work, satisfying the new criterion by named evidence is the step that makes the close honest, and the remedy never names it.

Expected: the refusal names the whole path. Add a criterion with `intent ac new`, then satisfy it with `intent ac satisfy --evidence <ref> <STID> <ACID>` (or prove a test criterion green), or cancel the unit.

It is XS and a 3.2.1 item. Routing (vc): ic, as remedy wording; vc judges.

## Scope widened (vc, 2026-09-23, on ic's measurement): two more instances of the same refusal, and it is size S

**1. The emptied-contract arm names the same half path** (`contract.rs:690`): "Add one with `intent ac new`, bring one back with `intent ac rescope` or `intent ac reinstate`, or cancel the unit". A criterion brought back is not satisfied either: `ac_reinstate` and `ac_rescope` return it to its kind's entry state (`AcState::entry`), which is unsatisfied for a non-test criterion and computed from covering tests for a test-backed one, never to what it held before it left scope. So following that refusal also ends in a second refusal. `intent/docs/working-with-llms.md` paraphrases the same half path and is corrected with it.

**2. The `remedy:` line under both refusals contradicts them.** It is `GateBlocked`'s fixed text (`facade.rs:2435`), the same under every gate block, so it is right only for the tally arm. Driven on the pair at 099088acd, in a scratch project under an isolated `HOME`:

```
  $ intent wp done ST0001/01
  error: ST0001/01 is not ready to close -- gate: ST0001/01 BLOCKED -- the thread has zero acceptance criteria (empty contract). Define ACs with `intent ac new`, or cancel the unit with `intent st cancel` or `intent wp cancel`.
    remedy: satisfy or formally descope the remaining criteria, then close again
```

Under an empty contract it names criteria that do not exist; under an emptied one, the only criteria there are the ones out of scope. vc ruled that it rides in 0526, because the user reads the error and its remedy line as one message: each arm of the gate supplies its own remedy, and the tally arm keeps `GateBlocked`'s.

**3. `docs/known-defects.md` records the remedy-line defect under `intent#0063`, which is CLOSED.** 0063 closed on 2026-09-04 over `WpStatus::Cancelled`; the remedy line is still live on 3.2.0, and no open issue carried it until this one. The entry changes when the page is re-driven whole at the 3.2.1 cut, never one entry against a dev build (vc accepted ic's correction on that).

**Size S, was XS.** The routing is unchanged: ic builds, vc judges.
